1.title: U.S. Cuts Ties With Organ Donor Group After Reports of Abuses
1.summary: The federal government is ending its contract with a Kentucky nonprofit that it says pressured medical workers to remove organs from patients who were getting better.

2.title: Why Congress Wants a Closer U.S.-Israel Defense Partnership
2.summary: A proposal making its way through Congress would integrate the U.S. and Israeli defense and intelligence apparatuses more tightly. Some worry that it is a bad idea.

3.title: Perez Hilton Is Hospitalized After Appearing to Harm Himself on Livestream
3.summary: Law enforcement and emergency workers responded to Mr. Hilton’s house after he appeared to hurt himself on a TikTok stream Tuesday.

4.title: Finland Tries to Protect Children Against Deepfakes, With Russia in Mind
4.summary: Finland, wary of misinformation from Moscow and beyond, has a leg up on other nations in spotting fake news. But A.I. is a whole new challenge.

5.title: After deadly Kyiv strike, Ukraine warns interceptor shortage is costing lives
5.summary: Without Patriot interceptors, Ukraine's skies are wide open and people are fully exposed to Russia's missile barrages.

6.title: Record-Breaking Heat Wave in South Korea Leads to Canceled Baseball Games
6.summary: The country has been gripped by a record-setting heat wave that endangered both players and spectators.
